title: Add Python 3.14 to the CI test matrix

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: CI runs the suite on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and `publish.yml`), but the tool is developed and run on 3.14, and the code now carries 3.14-specific behavior -- S117 forces `argparse` `color=False` (a 3.14+ parameter) so usage/help/errors stay plain. Nothing in CI exercises 3.14, so a 3.14-only regression (color, or anything else the newer stdlib changes) would ship unnoticed, including into a release.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `python-version` matrix)
- `.github/workflows/publish.yml` (its matrix, and the pinned build/publish Python if appropriate)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. The CI matrix includes `"3.14"` alongside 3.11-3.13.
2. The full suite passes on 3.14 (already true locally -- this makes it enforced).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add `"3.14"` to the `python-version` matrix in `ci.yml` (and `publish.yml`'s test matrix). Confirm the suite is green on 3.14 in CI. Keep 3.11 as the floor. If any 3.14-only failure surfaces, fix it or guard it by version as S117 did.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: CI runs and passes on 3.11-3.14. The local suite still passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit. Do not tag or push.
